parameters.name: AgentDescription
parameters.description: The description of the agent capabilities.

parameters.name: AgentDisplayName
parameters.description: The display name of the agent.

parameters.name: AgentHost
parameters.description: The endpoint domain name through which the agent provides external services.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: Provides idempotency. Within 3 minutes, the same value takes effect only once.

parameters.name: Endpoints
parameters.description: The endpoint configuration of the agent.

sub_parameters.name: AgentUrl
sub_parameters.description:
The actual service address of the agent endpoint, which is the HTTPS entry point where the agent runs online. This is a required field with a maximum of 500 characters.
- Example: https://my-agent.example.com/mcp

After a caller discovers this agent through DNS, the caller uses this URL to initiate a connection. This is the address where the agent is actually online.

sub_parameters.name: MetadataUrl
sub_parameters.description:
An optional URL that points to the metadata description file of the agent (typically in JSON format). This allows other agents or clients to automatically discover the agent capabilities before connecting, including:
- Functions supported by the agent
- Input/output formats
- Version information
- Other capability declarations

sub_parameters.name: Protocol
sub_parameters.description:
The communication protocol standard that the agent endpoint follows. This determines how callers interact with the agent.

Valid values:
- MCP: Model Context Protocol, an agent tool calling protocol developed by Anthropic.
- A2A: Agent-to-Agent Protocol, a cross-agent communication protocol developed by Google.
- OpenAPI: Standard RESTful API specification (Swagger/OpenAPI).

Other agents or clients use this protocol identity to determine how to invoke the agent. For example, MCP uses the MCP SDK, A2A uses the A2A SDK, and OpenAPI uses standard HTTP requests.

parameters.name: RegistrantId
parameters.description: The ID of the registrant who has completed real-name verification. Obtain this ID by invoking the real-name verification API operation or from the ATS console.
